name: dropbox
description: Connect Dropbox to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Dropbox MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Dropbox to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with files and folders using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Dropbox workspace.
Find anything in Dropbox that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review files and folders in Dropbox.
